# Code review: GTF Safe-pays relay on mobile

**Mode:** full review of the committed range `cd18bc4…HEAD` only, as you asked, so uncommitted and untracked files are excluded. 29 files, +1,178 −124, base `aa6a278` → `e4c8fb4`.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | **Fix before opening the PR**: 2 must-fix issues (P1), both about fee wording shown to users |
| **Score** | **~71 / 100** (adjudicated 3 of 10; unadjudicated findings count at full weight) |
| **Held down by** | Bugs (fees shown wrong) and testing (the "must relay" guards have no tests) |
| **Fix first** | Show the fee breakdown only where GTF is enabled and gas is paid from the Safe, and change the "Free / Sponsored by Safe" text for Safe-pays transactions |

## Scores by area (worst first)

| Area | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Bugs | 55 | 2 × P1 |
| Testing | 72 | 1 × P2, 2 × P3 |
| DRY | 88 | 2 × P3, 1 cosmetic |
| KISS | 94 | 1 × P3 |
| Conventions | 100 | 1 cosmetic (no score weight) |
| Security, regression, architecture, performance | 100 | none |

## What this review did not cover
- Uncommitted work, including the untracked `.claude/skills/code-conventions/` and `docs/engineering/`.
- No tests, app runs or type-check. Everything was read from the code.
- How the backend handles `safeTxHash` and `acceptUnverifiedSimulation` on its side (not in this repo).
- Scores use a simplified deduction. Only the top 3 findings went through adjudication; the other 7 were not.
- `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv` was not written, because you asked for read-only.

## Must fix before opening

**1. The fee breakdown shows "FREE" and "0 gas" on every pending transaction, on every chain** (P1 · bugs · validator confirmed, refuter weakened)
- `apps/mobile/src/features/ConfirmTx/components/TransactionInfo/TransactionInfo.tsx:49` renders `FeesBreakdown` with no `FEATURES.GTF` check.
- `apps/mobile/src/features/ConfirmTx/components/TransactionInfo/FeesBreakdown.tsx:106` shows `maxGasFee` even when `paidFromSafe` is false. For an ordinary transaction, `feeRows.ts:64` computes `(safeTxGas+baseGas)*gasPrice = 0`.
- **Result:** every co-signer on every chain sees "Execution fee FREE · Max gas fee 0 MATIC · Paid from the signer". Web hides all of this behind `useHasFeature(FEATURES.GTF)` and shows "Calculated at execution" instead of a number.
- **Mitigation (refuter):** the execute screen also shows a live network-fee estimate, and signing alone really does cost $0. So this is inconsistent wording, not a hidden charge.
- **Fix:** show the component only where GTF is enabled. Show the gas amount only when `paidFromSafe` is true, the same check `TokenTransfer.tsx:48` already does.

**2. Safe-pays transactions are labelled "Free / Sponsored by Safe"** (P1 · bugs · validator confirmed at 90, refuter weakened)
- Relay is now forced for these transactions (`helpers.ts:43`, `HowToExecuteSheet.container.tsx:104-112`), but the wording was not changed:
  - `HowToExecuteSheet/components/RelayAvailable/RelayAvailable.tsx:19-29` says "Sponsored by Safe · We pay transactions fees for you · {remaining} left / day". The count can be "0 left / day", since the daily limit is skipped.
  - `ExecuteTx/components/RelayFee/RelayFee.tsx:27` shows "Free" right above the execute button (reached through `EstimatedNetworkFee.tsx:49`).
- In reality the Safe pays the relayer back through `handlePayment`.
- **Mitigation (refuter):** the correct "Paid from your Safe" line exists, but only inside the info tooltip on the confirm screen.
- **Fix:** pass `requiresRelay` down to both components. Show the Safe-paid fee instead of "Free", and hide the daily count.

## Worth a ticket

| # | P | File:line | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | P2 | `HowToExecuteSheet/HowToExecuteSheet.container.tsx:99-118, 150-186` and `ExecuteTx/components/ReviewAndExecute/ReviewAndExecuteContainer.tsx:136-144, 165-167` | The "no signer fallback" guards have no tests (confirmed by both agents). On chains without relaying, `getExecutionMethod` deliberately falls back to `WITH_PK` (`helpers.test.ts:110-119`), so these container guards are the only thing stopping the double-pay route. |
| 4 | P3 | `ConfirmTx/components/confirmation-views/TokenTransfer/TokenTransfer.tsx:39-52` | The new `safePaidFee` header amount has no tests. |
| 5 | P3 | `ConfirmTx/components/TransactionInfo/FeesBreakdown.tsx:96, 140-141` | No component test for the null-return case or the "Paid from your Safe / signer" wording. |
| 6 | P3 | `ExecuteTx/hooks/useTransactionExecution.ts:45, 130-133, 151-155` | `simulationError` and `retryWithAcceptUnverified` are dead code: nothing reads them, and `useExecutionFlow` already owns this flow. |
| 7 | P3 | `ConfirmTx/components/TransactionInfo/FeesBreakdown.tsx:21-23` | Tooltip text is copied from web's `features/gtf/components/shared/tooltips.ts` and has already drifted: "…on the blockchain." is missing. |
| 8 | P3 | `ConfirmTx/components/TransactionInfo/feeRows.ts:94-104` | The "same token → one summed line" rule re-implements web's `features/gtf/services/totalOutgoing.ts:97-133`. `packages/AGENTS.md` says shared logic goes in `packages/`. |
| 9 | — | `ExecuteTx/components/IndeterminateSimulationSheet/IndeterminateSimulationSheet.tsx:1-56` and `HowToExecuteSheet/components/RelayUnavailableSheet/RelayUnavailableSheet.tsx:1-49` | The same bottom-sheet boilerplate is copied a third time; `SoftUpdatePrompt.tsx` already has it. |
| 10 | — | Same two folders | Missing the `index.ts` barrel that all 7 sibling folders have (`apps/mobile/docs/code-style.md:10-19`). The imports therefore go straight to the file. |

## Your call

| # | Suggested |
|---|---|
| 1, 2 | Fix now |
| 3 | Fix now, since it is cheap next to 1 and 2 |
| 4–8 | Fix or ticket |
| 9, 10 | Optional |

## Worth tidying
The tidy-ups are already listed above as #6 (delete the dead state and its 3 tests) and #10 (add the barrels). Together that's about 20 lines. Nothing else was proposed.

## Not sure · ruled out · not checked
- **Not sure (below the confidence cut-off, not filed):**
  - `relayErrors.ts:23` `SIMULATION_CODES` copies the generated union at `AUTO_GENERATED/relay.ts:58` by hand.
  - `relayExecutor.ts:63` now fails every relay execution if `getSafeSDK()` isn't set. The WalletConnect executor already has the same guard.
- **Ruled out:**
  - Moving `isGtfSafePaid` and `relayErrors` into `packages/utils`: exact content moves, no leftover imports of the old paths, and the jest preset covers the new test locations.
  - The "Safe-pays must relay" routing, including the Ledger and biometrics paths: the relay route always takes the standard path.
  - No security findings: `acceptUnverifiedSimulation` is only set after the user explicitly confirms in the sheet.
- **Not checked:** backend handling of the relay flag, and running the app on a device.

## How this was produced
- Three category agents covered all nine areas.
- I added finding #2 myself and merged the ungated-GTF issue into finding #1.
- Findings 1–3 were each checked by a validator and a refuter. Results: 3 confirmed, 2 of them weakened, 0 refuted, 0 duplicates.
- No files were changed and nothing was posted.
